subject: Quick sync: projected monthly token burn and procurement decision gates
messages:
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Subject: Quick sync: projected monthly token burn and procurement decision gates

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Wanted to capture a short recap and the concrete numbers we need to align on so we can scope the pilot SOW and procurement lane.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary use: clinical summarization + triage assistant for care coordinators.
- Expected initial concurrency: small set of workflows (5–7 agents) ramping from pilot -> prod.
- Your ops estimate: ~4–6M tokens / month at launch, scaling to ~10–12M over 3–6 months (you mentioned seasonal spikes).

Open asks (please confirm the bullets below)
1) Confirm monthly spend band (ballpark): tokens / month and your target $/1M tokens.
   - Example buckets we typically use: 0–3M, 3–10M, 10–25M tokens/month with sliding unit rates.
2) Procurement thresholds we should plan for at your end: PO requirement, internal approvals, suggested lead times.
3) Any constraints on billing method for pilot (credit card vs PO vs invoice)?

My working assumptions / what we can offer for pilot path
- Pilot (0–6 months): up to 6M tokens/mo covered by credits or card + standard API terms.
- If you want invoice/PO from day one we can do that for >$15k/mo (legal & finance need a PO number).
- Pricing: illustrative target shown below — we’ll formalize based on the exact model and quantization profile.
   - 0–3M tokens: $1,200 / 1M tokens (illustrative)
   - 3–10M tokens: $900 / 1M tokens (illustrative)
   - 10M+ tokens: custom (dedicated pricing / reserved capacity)

Attachments: I’ve attached a quick MonthlyEstimate worksheet that maps your 4/6/12M token scenarios to monthly spend at those illustrative rates (BrightPath_MonthlyEstimate.xlsx).

Next steps (proposed)
- Alex: confirm the concrete monthly token target for pilot (best guess fine) and whether procurement requires a PO for pilot.
- Karthik: I’m looping you to review the unit economics and ensure we have the right pricing band to propose.
- I’ll send a first-pass SOW and a pilot costing breakdown by EOD.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down so we can get procurement moving.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

Confirmed estimates
- Pilot (months 0–3): 4–6M tokens/month (this aligns with the pilot cohort we discussed).
- Post-pilot (months 4–9): expect to ramp toward 10–12M tokens/month assuming good accuracy and latency numbers.

Budget and unit economics
- Our target cost benchmark is roughly $900 / 1M tokens (we can stretch to $1,100 for certain high-value summarization flows), but we’d prefer to see the itemized breakdown that shows how batching / KV caching reduces per-token cost.

Procurement reality at BrightPath
- We can use corporate card for Proof-of-Concept purchases up to $8k total.
- For recurring monthly invoices, procurement requires a PO when monthly invoiced amount exceeds $20k.
- Standard procurement lead time for legal / security review is 10–14 business days; if possible we’d like a concise SOW to speed review.

Next items from us
- I’ve attached our internal PO guidelines for reference (BP-PO-guidelines.pdf). Procurement has asked for: expected monthly spend ranges, billing cadence, and SLA summary.

If you can get the SOW + breakdown in the next 48 hours, procurement will prioritize the review.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Product Integrations | BrightPath Health
alex@brightpathhealth.com

Alex — perfect, this is helpful. I’ve updated the attached SOW draft and a short pilot costing CSV to reflect the 4/6/12M scenarios you called out. Key clarifications and proposed procurement path below.

What we propose (conservative path to get pilot running quickly)
- Pilot payment: use corporate card up to $8k (you mentioned this is available). We’ll also provide a $10k credit to smooth the initial months so procurement has runway.
- If you want invoiced billing from day one we can accept a PO for pilot but procurement will need to supply PO number before first invoice; our finance policy requires PO for monthly invoices > $15k.
- If monthly spend moves above $20k (as you noted), procurement PO is expected and legal may request a short amendment to the master services agreement. We’ll surface any legal changes up front.

Draft illustrative pricing (to align expectations)
- 4M tokens/mo: ~ $3,600 / month (at $900 / 1M tokens)
- 6M tokens/mo: ~ $5,400 / month
- 12M tokens/mo: ~ $10,800 / month

These are ballpark until we lock model, quantization, and batching profile — Karthik is validating optimizations that can push effective unit to ~$700–850 / 1M tokens for steady-state batching.

Next steps (I will own these)
- I attached: SOW-draft.pdf and pilot-costing-breakdown.csv.
- Karthik will follow up with a short note on batching/quantization levers that matter for BrightPath flows (within 24 hours).
- Alex / procurement: if you can share a PO template and the name of the procurement contact we’ll route the SOW directly.

Planned timeline
- EOD Monday: finalized SOW + itemized invoice example plugged with your 4/6M numbers.
- Procurement review: you (Alex) target 10–14 business days once the PO + SOW are submitted.

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the estimate and attach these docs.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Quick sync: projected monthly token burn and procurement decision gates

Hi Alex / Vanessa — looping in Monica from finance so we can align on invoice / PO lead times. A couple notes from infra/pricing side:

1) Unit econ levers that matter for your flows
   - Batching: steady request patterns (worker-style summarization) should let us batch and reduce compute by ~15–30% depending on latency SLO.
   - KV/prefix caching for clinical templates: if you can pin common prefixes we often see >20% token savings on repeated prompts.
   - Model variant: small increase in latency but 8-bit quantized weights reduce cost materially. We’ll include two model options in the SOW.

2) Procurement / billing specifics (Redwood finance)
   - PO preferred for any monthly invoice > $15,000.
   - If BrightPath can provide a PO number prior to first invoice, we’ll invoice monthly net-30.
   - If you prefer monthly card billing for pilot, we can accept that up to the pilot cap Vanessa proposed.
   - Legal lead time: simple amend/acceptance ~10 business days; complex SOC/Security addendum may take longer — please surface any redlines early.

3) Next step items I’ll deliver
   - Short tech note on batching/kv/caching impact (pdf) — targeted delivery: Monday EOD.
   - Example invoice with the 4/6/12M lines populated so procurement sees the numbers in their PO template.

Thanks — Monica, when you have 2 minutes can you confirm the PO routing address and the finance contact at BrightPath?

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
